fieldChecks.label: Local Rain Records
fieldChecks.method: Local precipitation records, snow timing and temperature for the catchment, by month.

fieldChecks.label: Herd Records
fieldChecks.method: Animal numbers by species, residence time, access routes, pasture area and seasonal movements.

fieldChecks.label: Orchard History
fieldChecks.method: Crop, orchard and irrigation history for 2019 to 2025, and botanical composition.

fieldChecks.label: Seasonal Calendar
fieldChecks.method: Local seasonal calendar and shadow and snow quality checks.

fieldChecks.label: Scene Inspection
fieldChecks.method: Independent manual inspection of the source scenes and repeat processing.

explanations.label: Rainfall
explanations.statement: Lower rainfall in the wet season before lowered vegetation greenness in the catchment.

explanations.label: Grazing
explanations.statement: Grazing on the shared pastures lowered vegetation greenness in the catchment.

explanations.label: Land use
explanations.statement: A change in land use, such as cropland or buildings replacing pasture, lowered vegetation greenness in parts of the catchment.

explanations.label: Snow or terrain
explanations.statement: Snow cover or terrain shadow in the satellite scenes lowered the measured greenness without a change in the vegetation.

explanations.label: Data artefact
explanations.statement: Too few clear scenes or a processing artefact in the vegetation record produced the low values without a change in the vegetation.
